overview: Pillagers have taken to the sea. Out on open water there are ships now: whole, afloat and crewed, with the plunder still in their chests.

1.1.0: With Pandorical on the server and your client, the crew dresses as pirates.
The captain wears a tricorne, an eyepatch and a gold-trimmed coat.
Deckhands wear bandanas, striped shirts, eyepatches, earrings and sashes.
Without Pandorical they are plain pillagers, as before.
A mod menu icon of a pillager in a tricorne and eyepatch.
1.0.1: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
1.0.0: Four crewed ships sail the open water: sloop, longship, brigantine and galleon.
Built the way the vanilla shipwrecks are, two woods and flared hulls and log masts.
Each is drawn from its own seed, so no two are quite alike.
